title: daysBetween is wrong around clock changes
prompt: daysBetween(a, b) in src/dates.js returns the number of whole days from date a to date b (both "YYYY-MM-DD" strings). Customers in New York get off-by-one answers for ranges that cross the March clock change, e.g. daysBetween("2024-03-09", "2024-03-11") should be 2. Please fix it so it is right regardless of the machine's timezone.
